QEVA OBJECT 0.2 · EXPERIMENT 0.1 · RUN 0.1 · OBSERVATION 0.1 · RELEASE ENVELOPE 0.5

A small grammar, not a permanent software stack.

A future reader needs to recover what was asserted, under which framework, from which exact dependencies, with what evidence and history. JSON is the present transport; the field meanings are the durable part.

THE KNOWLEDGE OBJECT

Every record is inspectable without QEVA.

An object identifier remains stable; a revision reference is immutable. Dependencies always pin an exact revision.

qeva:1:prime       stable object identifier
qeva:1:prime@2     exact immutable revision

object = {
  identity, revision, kind, domains,
  context, assumptions,
  plain explanation, exact statement, example, caveat,
  exact dependencies, typed relations,
  verification performed, provenance, supersession
}

FIVE SEPARATIONS

The protocol refuses convenient category errors.

SYNTAX ≠ SEMANTICS

A legal expression has not thereby acquired a meaning.

DERIVATION ≠ UNIVERSAL TRUTH

A proof is relative to declared premises and rules; truth is evaluated in a declared interpretation.

CITATION ≠ DEPENDENCE

Historical influence and formal prerequisite are stored in different layers.

SIMULATION ≠ PROOF

Experiments can reveal and refute, but finite evidence does not settle a universal claim.

ACCESS ≠ PERMISSION

Retrieval does not grant a right to redistribute the retrieved text.

EDITORIAL ≠ FORMAL

A readable seed record is not promoted to machine-checked merely because it looks precise.

COMPATIBILITY

Append, supersede, never silently rewrite.

Existing exact revisions remain byte-preserved. A change creates a new revision with a pointer to the one it supersedes. Independent qualification assertions can accumulate without mutating the subject. Incompatible semantics require a new declared protocol version.

FOUNDATIONAL PLURALISM

QEVA has roots, not one fake absolute root.

“From first principles” means every dependency eventually reaches a declared boundary. It does not mean set theory, type theory, category theory, logic, or physical reality can be smuggled in as the one unquestionable substrate.
